end.summary:
Practised distinguishing points, segments, lines and rays by endpoints; some answers were right but not steady yet.
Practised naming segments, lines and rays, including that ray AB starts at A; this still needs checking next time.
Aryan first treated a longer drawing as a different line, then corrected this by using the arrows to identify the full line.
Aryan first said a ray has two endpoints, then corrected this later: a ray has one endpoint and continues with an arrow.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying figures by their endpoints and naming them with letters. Aryan used the torch-light example for a ray and later corrected the mix-up about a ray having two endpoints; the difference between ray AB and ray BA still needs more practice. At home, draw one segment, line and ray, then ask Aryan to mark the endpoints and name each one, checking that ray AB starts at A.
